## Before you submit

Group members are recorded as Hussnain Haider (i230695) and Akbar Hussain (i233094) in `README.md`, on the report title page and in `scripts/report_content.py`, which is the single source the other two are generated from. Change it there and rebuild if anything is wrong.

One thing the code cannot do for you:

1. **Record the 2–3 minute Loom video.** A shot-by-shot script with timings is in `docs/VIVA_PREPARATION.md` § Demonstration script. Run `python scripts/run_evaluation.py --mode text --max-turns 6` beforehand so the screens have data and you are not waiting on camera.

Then submit the repository link (private) or a `.zip` with the same contents to Google Classroom.
